styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Colonial churches, museums and the old centre.

styles.label: History
styles.blurb: Old town, national museums and nearby colonial towns.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Hill views, parks and day trips into the green highlands.

stays.why: Walk to the cathedral, plazas and main museums. Busiest by day; quiet and empty after dark.
Cheapest beds and local markets across the river. Avoid walking here after dark.
Modern hotels, restaurants and malls. Easy taxi and ride-app pickups.
Quiet, hilly, upscale area with the safest-feeling streets and good views.

food: Try baleadas: thick flour tortillas with beans, cheese or egg. Cheap and everywhere.
Look for Honduran plates: grilled meat with rice, beans and fried plantain.
Sopa de caracol (conch soup) and seafood are worth ordering at coastal-style places.
Markets in Comayagüela are good for cheap local snacks by day; go with a local or by taxi.
Coffee is a local pride: ask for Honduran beans at cafés on Boulevard Morazán.
more_time: Add a day trip to Valle de Ángeles or Santa Lucía, small colonial towns in the hills. Check transport on the day.
Swap a city afternoon for a museum or a viewpoint; ask your hotel which are open that day.
With more time, consider a longer trip toward Copán Ruinas. It is far, so plan an overnight.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the old centre, museums and a hill-town day trip without rushing.

month_notes: January: mild and fairly dry, about 26°C by day and 16°C at night. Good for walking.
February: the driest month, around 5 rain days. Comfortable days near 28°C.
March: warm and mostly dry, highs near 30°C. Start early for sightseeing.
April: hotter at about 31°C with more showers (11 rain days). Carry a light rain jacket.
May: rainy season starts, around 19 rain days. Plan indoor sights and afternoon breaks.
June: wet, about 25 rain days. Expect heavy afternoon rain; keep plans flexible.
July: still wet (20 rain days) but a little cooler at 27°C. Mornings are usually best.
August: rainy again, around 23 rain days. Pack waterproof shoes.
September: the wettest month, about 26 rain days. Check road and trip conditions on the day.
October: still very wet (26 rain days), highs near 26°C. Good museum weather.
November: rain eases to about 18 days and days cool to 25°C. A pleasant shoulder month.
December: drier (12 rain days) and cool at night (17°C). A good month to visit.

climate_guide.summary: Mild highland climate: warm days, cool nights, and a long rainy season from May to October.

items.title: Best time: December to March
items.text: Days around 25–30°C and nights near 16–17°C, with the fewest rain days. Ideal for walking the centre.

items.title: Rainy season May to October
items.text: Rain days climb to 19–26 a month. Showers often come in the afternoon; plan indoor sights then.

items.title: Mild, not tropical-hot
items.text: Highs stay between 25 and 31°C all year thanks to the altitude. Nights are cool, 16–19°C.

items.title: Pack a light layer
items.text: Evenings and early mornings are cool. Bring a light jacket and an umbrella in the wet months.

items.title: Wet-season shoes
items.text: Streets and hills can be slick from May to October. Waterproof shoes help.

items.title: Shoulder months
items.text: November and April are in-between: some rain, comfortable temperatures, fewer crowds.

transit.best: Uber or a taxi with the price agreed first; buses only if you're saving money.

modes.text: No metro or tram. Don't plan around rail in the city.
City buses run fixed routes but stops are unlabeled; look for crowds on the sidewalk. Colectivos follow set routes and often have long lines.
Taxis are everywhere; agree the price before you get in and walk away from high offers. Uber works and is often safer and about half the taxi price; drivers may ignore the app map.
An option for hill-town day trips. Traffic is busy and streets are steep; check your licence needs first.
Fine in the centre by day. Avoid strolling Comayagüela after dark.
